nodeTemplateDescriptions.triggerCommand: Start workflow when user sends a command
nodeTemplateDescriptions.triggerText: Start workflow when message text matches a pattern
nodeTemplateDescriptions.triggerCallback: Start workflow from inline button click
nodeTemplateDescriptions.triggerSchedule: Start workflow on a recurring schedule
nodeTemplateDescriptions.triggerAI: Start workflow by AI intent / semantic match (soon)
nodeTemplateDescriptions.message: Send text, images, or media to user
nodeTemplateDescriptions.messageAI: Generate message text with AI (fallback supported)
nodeTemplateDescriptions.conditionAI: Branch by AI classification / intent (fallback available)
nodeTemplateDescriptions.router: Branch to multiple paths by variable value
nodeTemplateDescriptions.wait: Pause workflow until the next user event
nodeTemplateDescriptions.script: Run JavaScript or Python transform code
nodeTemplateDescriptions.setVariable: Assign a value to a variable
nodeTemplateDescriptions.http: Make HTTP requests to external APIs
nodeTemplateDescriptions.comment: Add an internal note to document the flow
nodeTemplateDescriptions.paymentStars: Create payment link via Telegram Stars

triggerCommand.step1: Open trigger settings, choose "Command" and set a command (for example, /start).
triggerCommand.step2: You can provide multiple commands separated by commas for shared entry logic.
triggerCommand.step3: Connect this trigger to Message or logic nodes to start the flow.

triggerText.step1: Set text or pattern that should start this workflow.
triggerText.step2: Reply Keyboard clicks arrive as plain text, so handle them with Text Trigger.
triggerText.step3: Connect it to Message or Condition/Router for next-step handling.

triggerCallback.step1: Set inline button callback_data in a Message node.
triggerCallback.step2: Use the same callback pattern in Callback Trigger to catch the click.
triggerCallback.step3: Connect this trigger to the branch that should run after the button press.

triggerSchedule.step2: Set run time and optional target chat/user for delivery.
triggerSchedule.step3: Connect to nodes that must run automatically on schedule.

triggerAI.step1: Describe the required intent/semantic pattern in AI Prompt.
triggerAI.step2: Keep fallback logic so flow remains stable if AI classification fails.
triggerAI.step3: Connect it to the response branch for the detected intent.

message.step1: Set message text and parse mode if formatting is needed.
message.step2: Add buttons or media when user actions are required.
message.step3: Use variable placeholders in message text (double curly braces) to inject dynamic user/context data.

messageAI.step1: Fill AI Prompt with the expected response style and output format.
messageAI.step2: Set fallback text for cases when AI is unavailable.
messageAI.step3: Place this node after a trigger where dynamic AI response is needed.

condition.step1: Pick variable, operator, and value for the condition check.
condition.step2: Top output is True branch, bottom output is False branch.
condition.step3: Connect both branches so the workflow has a defined path.

conditionAI.step1: Define True/False classification rules in AI Prompt.
conditionAI.step3: Connect separate actions for True and False branches.

router.step1: Choose variable used for multi-branch routing.
router.step2: Add cases and match values for each output path.
router.step3: Connect each case and the default output for unmatched values.

scheduler.step1: Choose mode: delay or exact date/time.
scheduler.step2: Set timezone and optional variable to store scheduler output.
scheduler.step3: Connect to the step that must execute later.

wait.step1: Choose what event resumes the flow, for example the next user message.
wait.step2: Set timeout if the pause must expire automatically.
wait.step3: Connect the next node that should run after the wait is resumed.

replyKeyboard.step1: Choose keyboard mode: system, variant, hide, or condition-based.
replyKeyboard.step2: Reply Keyboard presses are handled by Text Trigger, not Callback Trigger.
replyKeyboard.step3: Run Test in Telegram to verify keyboard layout per scenario.

script.step1: Choose runtime language (JavaScript/Python) and input source.
script.step2: Use input/context/vars in code and assign final value to result.
script.step3: Save result to a variable if next nodes need this value.

action.step1: Choose action type and configure required parameters.
action.step2: Set target variable when action output should be stored.
action.step3: Connect next nodes that consume updated data.

setVariable.step1: Set the variable name that should be updated.
setVariable.step2: Enter a static value or a template like '{{callback.data}}'.
setVariable.step3: Connect the next node that uses the updated value.

input.step1: Set the question prompt sent to the user.
input.step2: Provide variable name to save the user response.
input.step3: Connect to the next node that uses this captured input.

http.step1: Set request URL, method, and optional headers/body.
http.step2: Configure timeout and variable for storing API response.
http.step3: Add next-step handling (Message, Condition, Router) for response data.

comment.step1: Add a note describing why this branch exists or what assumptions it has.
comment.step2: Use comments for team handoff, TODOs, or documenting edge cases.
comment.step3: Comments are ignored by runtime, so they do not need outgoing connections.

paymentYookassa.step1: Set shopId/secretKey, amount, and return URL.
paymentYookassa.step2: Enable auto-send link if the user should immediately receive the payment URL.
paymentYookassa.step3: Save payment result to a variable and continue with Message/Condition logic.

paymentStripe.step1: Set Stripe secret key, amount, currency, and success/cancel URLs.
paymentStripe.step2: Set product name so Checkout session is clear to the user.
paymentStripe.step3: Save payment result to a variable and handle the next steps in your flow.

paymentRobokassa.step1: Set MerchantLogin, Password #1, amount, and currency.
paymentRobokassa.step2: Optionally enable test mode and define success/fail URLs.
paymentRobokassa.step3: Send generated link to the user and keep payment result in a variable.

paymentStars.step1: Set invoice title, amount in stars, and optional order payload.
paymentStars.step2: The node calls Telegram API (`createInvoiceLink`) and returns an XTR payment URL.
paymentStars.step3: Send this URL directly or use a Message inline button with type "Telegram Stars payment".

notes.trigger-command: Use command triggers for explicit entry points like `/start`, `/menu`, or `/help`.
notes.trigger-text: Use Text Trigger for reply keyboard presses and plain user text routing.
notes.trigger-callback: Callback Trigger works only with inline buttons configured in Message nodes.
notes.trigger-schedule: Always verify timezone and target chat/user for scheduled executions.
notes.trigger-ai: Keep a fallback branch for AI Trigger so flow remains stable when intent match fails.
notes.message: Use variable placeholders (double curly braces) for personalized message output.
notes.message-ai: Always keep fallback text for AI Message in case AI is unavailable.
notes.input: Use clear variable names (`name`, `phone`, `budget`) to simplify maintenance.
notes.condition: Connect both true/false outputs to avoid dead-end branches.
notes.condition-ai: Validate AI Logic on real examples before production rollout.
notes.router: Router is cleaner than long Condition chains when you have 3+ branches.
notes.scheduler: Double-check timezone for delays/date-time, especially in multi-region bots.
notes.reply-keyboard: Reply Keyboard sends plain text. Handle presses via Text Trigger.
notes.action: After Action, verify output in the next Message node or runtime logs.
notes.script: Keep scripts short and deterministic: input/context/vars in, result out.
notes.http: Set timeout and error handling for HTTP calls to avoid blocked flows.
notes.webhook: Webhook/HTTP steps need a stable endpoint and response validation.
notes.payment-yookassa: Store payment keys as secrets only and test with correct test/live credentials.
notes.payment-stripe: Verify Stripe success/cancel URLs and amount/currency consistency.
notes.payment-robokassa: Robokassa requires valid merchant credentials and callback verification flow.
notes.payment-stars: Use Telegram Stars via inline buttons or links, not Reply Keyboard.
notes.wait: Wait/Scheduler relies on runtime session state; account for process restarts in tests.
notes.comment: Comment node does not affect execution; use it as in-flow documentation.
